about_the_game:
The Virelia Research Station has stood silent for years—until now.

An unknown signal reactivates the transmitter, and a lone astronaut sets out to discover what happened to the old base. What they find, however, is no longer human. Behind the metal walls, alien life has sprouted: fungal-like tendrils and organic structures have taken over every part of the station. Something is alive—and it is growing.

Little Astronaut is an atmospheric sci-fi puzzle game where exploration, silence, and visual storytelling create the experience. No combat, no dialogue—just you, the machines, and the alien nature slowly reclaiming the space. A mysterious, discovery-driven adventure for fans of Cocoon, Inside, and The Swapper.

🔑 Key Features:

  • Environmental Puzzles – Activate systems, reroute power, and unlock the station’s sealed areas.

  • Mystical Sci-Fi Atmosphere – Lights, sounds, and the organic world of plants tell the story for you.

  • Visual Storytelling – No logs or texts—only the environment and its details guide your journey of discovery.

  • Music and Ambience – Subtle ambient melodies and the silence of space accompany your exploration.

If you enjoy the mood of Cocoon, The Swapper, Journey, or Inside, Little Astronaut will take you to an alien world where the station itself is alive, and every puzzle reveals a new mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.3GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.7GHz or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Explore the abandoned Virelia Research Station, where a world once shaped by human hands has been overtaken by an unknown, living growth. Solve environmental puzzles and uncover what awakened the station… and what has grown within it.
